description: This file is a code-behind for the EditExam.aspx page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It contains event handlers for button clicks that redirect the user to different pages within the OnlineExamSystem, such as AdminPanel, AdminQueue, AdminLeaderboard, EditTheory, EditMCQ, and LoginPage.

classes.name: EditExam
classes.description: The code-behind class for the EditExam.aspx page handling page events and user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently, it performs no actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button; redirects to AdminPanel.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the profile button; redirects to AdminQueue.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the leaderboard button; redirects to AdminLeaderboard.

methods.name: eTheoryB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for editing theory questions; redirects to EditTheory.

methods.name: eMcqB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for editing MCQ questions; redirects to EditMCQ.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for logout; redirects to LoginPage.
